statement: The site Lambda (open-university-web), its IAM role and its CloudFront front door are defined outside this repository's IaC stacks, and D-346 retired the runner-based canary alert and image rollback with no live synthetic canary replacing them; infrastructure drift or a broken deploy on the live site path has no IaC test or automated rollback.

treatment.plan: Import the site Lambda (open-university-web), its IAM role and its CloudFront distribution into infra/aws/stacks/ with stack tests, and add a read-only post-deploy HTTP synthetic canary over the live site URL (proposed separately in PR W under D-087); awaits owner decision on AWS/IaC scope.
